entities.name: Caduceus, Staff of Hermes
entities.description: A powerful artifact that can serve as a key, a weapon, and a way to attain great power.

entities.name: Layla Hassan
entities.description: A woman who says she went through hell to bring someone to where she is.

entities.name: Senu
entities.description: Bayek of Siwa's companion, whom he calls on to be his eyes.

entities.name: Bayek of Siwa
entities.description: A warrior who calls on Senu and vows to kill everyone involved in what happened that day in Siwa.

entities.name: Animus
entities.description: A machine that loads memory sequences; history cannot be changed within it, and death in it is only a temporary setback.

entities.name: Leonardo
entities.description: A friend of Ezio who remarks on the secret brotherhood's many new recruits.

entities.name: Ezio Auditore da Firenze
entities.description: An Assassin who works in the dark to serve the light; nephew of Mario Auditore.

entities.name: Jacob Frye
entities.description: An Assassin who favors brawling and direct action over stealth.

entities.name: Arno Dorian
entities.description: An Assassin who warns that the Creed's ideals can give way to dogma and fanaticism.

entities.name: The Creed
entities.description: The guiding principles of the Assassins.

entities.name: Aya of Alexandria
entities.description: A woman who defies Caesar, declaring that freedom is taken, not given.

entities.name: Clay Kaczmarek
entities.description: A man who speaks of people as the sum of their memories.

entities.name: Eivor
entities.description: A warrior who believes their destiny is theirs to weave, and who has a raven named Sýnin.

entities.name: Sýnin
entities.description: Eivor's raven.

entities.name: Mary Read
entities.description: A pirate paired with Anne Bonny.

entities.name: Anne Bonny
entities.description: A pirate who sees piracy as the most liberty a woman can find.

entities.name: Shao Jun
entities.description: An assassin who walks in darkness and strikes swiftly in her hunt.

entities.name: Assassins
entities.description: A secret brotherhood that works in the dark to serve the light and opposes the Templars.

entities.name: Abstergo Entertainment
entities.description: A company whose slogan is "We make history yours!"

entities.name: Edward "Blackbeard" Thatch
entities.description: A pirate who plans to relieve other ships of their riches.

entities.name: Al Mualim
entities.description: A man who tells Altaïr that there can be no peace while men retain free will.

entities.name: Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad
entities.description: An Assassin who rebukes an old man for not destroying the power he held.

entities.name: Ratonhnhaké꞉ton
entities.description: A warrior whose blade ended a desperate struggle between father and son.

entities.name: Maxwell Roth
entities.description: A showman who toasts those gathered to celebrate life and death.

entities.name: Darius
entities.description: A man who tells Kassandra there have always been people opposing those who lust for power.

entities.name: Kassandra
entities.description: A Spartan exile thrown from Mount Taygetos for trying to save her brother; she slew a beast of the Labyrinth.

entities.name: Cleopatra
entities.description: An exiled pharaoh who advises knowing one's enemies as kin.

entities.name: Crystal Skull, Isu Spyglass
entities.description: A device that can spy on anyone with a drop of their blood.

entities.name: Bartholomew "Black Bart" Roberts
entities.description: A pirate who promised himself a merry life and a short one.

entities.name: Jackdaw
entities.description: A ship.

entities.name: Venice
entities.description: A city whose thieves are dependable allies of the Assassins.

entities.name: Mount Taygetos
entities.description: The mountain from which Kassandra was thrown into exile.

entities.name: Hidden Ones
entities.description: A disciplined, patient order who waited for the perfect moment to strike and escape unnoticed.

entities.name: Rafiq Kadar
entities.description: A man who advises walking among scholars to reach restricted areas.

entities.name: Evie Frye
entities.description: An Assassin who favors careful planning over barging into combat.

entities.name: Minerva
entities.description: A being who speaks through a prophet rather than with him.

entities.name: Deimos
entities.description: A man who declares that those who don't stand with him stand against him.

entities.name: Anubis
entities.description: A god Bayek invokes as awaiting his foes.

entities.name: Aveline de Grandpré
entities.description: An Assassin who sends the unjust to the next world.

entities.name: Arbaaz Mir
entities.description: An Assassin who speaks of finding a cause worth fighting for.

entities.name: Basim Ibn Ishaq
entities.description: A man haunted by memories he never had, of a family that was never his.

entities.name: Lydia Frye
entities.description: A woman who tells Winston Churchill she would settle for the right to vote.

entities.name: Winston Churchill
entities.description: A man Lydia Frye speaks to about the right to vote.

entities.name: Shaun
entities.description: An agent paired with Rebecca who values information as a weapon.

entities.name: Rebecca
entities.description: An agent paired with Shaun.

entities.name: Sigurd
entities.description: The Jarl of Ravensthorpe, who sails for further shores toward his true purpose.

entities.name: Caesar
entities.description: A ruler whom Aya of Alexandria defies.

entities.name: Adrestia
entities.description: A ship bearing the eagle.

entities.name: Excalibur, Sword of Eden
entities.description: A sword forged to end the Isu's war and wielded by humans to wage it.

entities.name: Isu
entities.description: An ancient people whose war Excalibur was forged to end.

entities.name: Leap of faith
entities.description: A sacred rite of the Assassins that strengthens resolve and purges fear.

entities.name: Eagle Vision
entities.description: A unique gift of some Assassins that reveals hidden marks and secrets.

entities.name: Monteriggioni
entities.description: The Brotherhood's headquarters, which Mario Auditore says will outlast her enemies.

entities.name: Mario Auditore
entities.description: Ezio's uncle and the patriarch of the Brotherhood at Monteriggioni.

entities.name: Siwa
entities.description: Bayek's home, where something happened that he vows to avenge.

entities.name: Gunnar of Ravensthorpe
entities.description: A blacksmith whose forge supplies the Raven Clan.

entities.name: Raven Clan
entities.description: A clan supplied by Gunnar's forge.

entities.name: Ravensthorpe
entities.description: A settlement ruled by Jarl Sigurd.

entities.name: Starrick
entities.description: A man who controls London and whom the Brotherhood seeks to stop.

entities.name: London
entities.description: A city the Assassins want to return to the people who built it.

entities.name: Jayadeep Mir
entities.description: A Brotherhood spy who wants to stop Starrick.

entities.name: Yusuf Tazim
entities.description: A veteran who explains the Ottoman hookblade.

entities.name: Pierre Bellec
entities.description: A mentor who warns that poison is no substitute for accuracy.

entities.name: Labyrinth
entities.description: A place where a beast claimed many lives before Kassandra slew it.

entities.name: Spartans
entities.description: Warriors who attack relentlessly.

entities.name: Surtr
entities.description: A fiery jötunn who taunts the Lord of Asgard.

entities.name: Asgard
entities.description: A realm whose lord Surtr challenges.

entities.name: Tahira
entities.description: The First Oath-Taker, who urges others not to let their creed fade.

entities.name: West Indies
entities.description: A region where the Assassins gained a foothold and hunted Templars.

entities.name: Templars
entities.description: The enemies of the Assassins.

entities.name: Greece
entities.description: A land whose economy ran on marble, controlled by the Cult of Kosmos.

entities.name: Cult of Kosmos
entities.description: A cult that controlled Greece by controlling the marble supply.

entities.name: Yerebatan Cistern
entities.description: A cistern in whose depths Ezio's prize was hidden from the Templars for centuries.

entities.name: Prince Suleiman
entities.description: A young prince whom Ezio aided while their intentions aligned.

events.summary: Ratonhnhaké꞉ton's blade ends a desperate struggle between a father and son.
events.quote: Ratonhnhaké꞉ton's blade found its mark, putting an end to the desperate struggle between father and son.

events.summary: Kassandra is thrown from Mount Taygetos into exile for trying to save her brother.
events.quote: For the crime of trying to save her brother, Kassandra was thrown from Mount Taygetos—forced into exile with nothing but a broken spear and the will to survive.

events.summary: Bayek vows to kill everyone involved in what happened that day in Siwa.
events.quote: And I will kill you all. Everyone who sniffed the air that day in Siwa.

events.summary: A beast that had claimed many lives in the Labyrinth is slain by Kassandra.
events.quote: It had claimed many lives in the Labyrinth before it met its end by Kassandra's hand.

events.summary: The Assassins gain a foothold in the West Indies and leave no safe places for Templars.
events.quote: Once the Assassins gained a foothold in the West Indies, they made sure there were no safe places left for Templars.

events.summary: The Cult of Kosmos controls Greece by controlling the marble supply.
events.quote: By controlling the supply, the Cult of Kosmos controlled Greece.

events.summary: Ezio's prize is hidden in the Yerebatan Cistern, kept safe from the Templars for hundreds of years.
events.quote: Ezio's prize remained hidden in the depths of the Yerebatan Cistern, kept safe from the Templars for hundreds of years.

events.summary: Ezio aids the young Prince Suleiman while their intentions align.
events.quote: Ezio was content to aid the young Prince Suleiman so long as their intentions remained aligned.
